export const meta = {
  name: 'proofread-pr6408-review',
  description: 'Adversarially verify each inline comment in the drafted PR #6408 review against the actual code',
  phases: [{ title: 'Verify', detail: 'one skeptic per inline comment' }],
}

const REPO = '/Users/ddobrin/work/dan/spring-ai'
const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  additionalProperties: false,
  properties: {
    id: { type: 'string' },
    anchorCorrect: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Do the cited line numbers actually contain the cited code?' },
    claimAccurate: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Is the described behavior/defect actually true in the code?' },
    overstated: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Is the wording stronger than the evidence supports?' },
    verdict: { type: 'string', enum: ['confirm', 'fix-anchor', 'soften', 'reject'] },
    correction: { type: 'string', description: 'If not confirm: the exact corrected line numbers and/or reworded claim. Empty if confirm.' },
    evidence: { type: 'string', description: 'Quote the actual code lines you read that prove or disprove the claim.' },
  },
  required: ['id', 'anchorCorrect', 'claimAccurate', 'overstated', 'verdict', 'correction', 'evidence'],
}

const items = [
  { id: 'model-merge', file: 'models/spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/image/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java', lines: '187-216', claim: 'In buildImagePrompt: builder.from(this.options) at ~L193 seeds model-level config, then builder.from(googleOptions) at ~L200 re-applies per-request options UNCONDITIONALLY. Combined with the Options constructor always baking a non-null default model, a per-request options object that did NOT call .model(...) silently overrides/downgrades the model-level configured model.' },
  { id: 'options-ctor', file: 'models/spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/image/GoogleGenAiImageOptions.java', lines: '132', claim: 'Constructor line 132 is this.model = (model != null ? model : DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME), forcing a non-null model into every options instance, so unset is indistinguishable from set-to-default under null-skip merge.' },
  { id: 'dead-creds', file: 'auto-configurations/models/spring-ai-autoconfigure-model-google-genai/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/model/google/genai/autoconfigure/image/GoogleGenAiImageConnectionAutoConfiguration.java', lines: '47,64-66', claim: 'A GoogleCredentials object is loaded from credentials-uri at L64-65 but is NEVER passed to the Client builder (dead variable); a misleading comment is at L66; the method declares throws IOException at L47. credentials-uri therefore has no effect.' },
  { id: 'text-parts', file: 'models/spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/image/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java', lines: '146-172,216', claim: 'configBuilder.responseModalities("TEXT","IMAGE") at L216 requests text, but response parsing maps only Part::inlineData (~L156); text Parts are silently dropped, so a text-only refusal yields an empty image result with no signal.' },
  { id: 'metadata-empty', file: 'models/spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/image/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java', lines: '163-172', claim: 'new Image(null, b64Json) at L163 has url=null; the GoogleGenAiImageGenerationMetadata at L165 is fed image.getUrl(), so gcsUri (and enhancedPrompt/raiFilteredReason) are always null; new ImageResponseMetadata() at L172 is empty.' },
  { id: 'original-prompt', file: 'models/spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/image/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java', lines: '110-132', claim: 'call() builds imagePrompt at L111 via buildImagePrompt(prompt) but then iterates prompt.getInstructions() (the ORIGINAL arg) at L132 instead of imagePrompt.getInstructions().' },
  { id: 'imagemessage', file: 'spring-ai-model/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/image/ImageMessage.java', lines: '37,66-94', claim: 'equals (L80-89) and hashCode (L91-94) use only text and weight; toString (L75-78) omits media and metadata; the media field (L37) is non-final; getMedia() (L66) returns the internal mutable list. The 4-arg ctor and new getters lack @since/Javadoc.' },
  { id: 'dup-prefix', file: 'auto-configurations/models/spring-ai-autoconfigure-model-google-genai/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/model/google/genai/autoconfigure/image/GoogleGenAiImageConnectionProperties.java', lines: '33,59', claim: 'GoogleGenAiImageConnectionProperties declares CONFIG_PREFIX = "spring.ai.google.genai.image" at L33, the SAME prefix that GoogleGenAiImageProperties (sibling file) declares at its L35. vertexAi field at L59 is bound but never read by the autoconfig.' },
  { id: 'nav-orphan', file: 'spring-ai-docs/src/main/antora/modules/ROOT/nav.adoc', lines: '51-54', claim: 'Image Models nav entries are at L52-54 (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Stability) and there is NO google-genai-image entry anywhere in nav.adoc. Also imageclient.adoc Available Implementations (~L158-163) lists openai/stabilityai but not google-genai.' },
  { id: 'docs-prefix', file: 'spring-ai-docs/src/main/antora/modules/ROOT/pages/api/image/google-genai-image.adoc', lines: '116-129', claim: 'The model-options property table (L116-129) uses keys with a ".options." segment (e.g. spring.ai.google.genai.image.options.n), but the actual @ConfigurationProperties binding is FLAT (spring.ai.google.genai.image.n) as shown by the Sample Controller / properties classes, so these documented keys will not bind.' },
  { id: 'docs-call-string', file: 'spring-ai-docs/src/main/antora/modules/ROOT/pages/api/image/google-genai-image.adoc', lines: '223-244', claim: 'Manual Configuration Java samples call imageModel.call("A painting of a sunset over a mountain") at L223-224 and L243-244. The ImageModel interface declares only call(ImagePrompt) (no String overload), so these samples do not compile.' },
  { id: 'docs-link', file: 'spring-ai-docs/src/main/antora/modules/ROOT/pages/api/image/google-genai-image.adoc', lines: '183', claim: 'The GitHub source link at L183 points to .../spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java — it OMITS the /image/ package segment (actual package is org.springframework.ai.google.genai.image), so the link 404s.' },
  { id: 'it-gating', file: 'auto-configurations/models/spring-ai-autoconfigure-model-google-genai/src/test/java/org/springframework/ai/model/google/genai/autoconfigure/image/GoogleGenAiImageAutoConfigurationIT.java', lines: '80-83', claim: 'The imageModelActivation test at L81 is annotated @EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable(named="GOOGLE_API_KEY") at L80, yet it only sets a fake property spring.ai.google.genai.image.api-key=test-key at L83 and asserts bean wiring — it needs no real credentials, so the gate needlessly skips it in CI.' },
]

const verdicts = (await parallel(items.map(it => () =>
  agent(
    `You are an adversarial verifier proofreading ONE inline comment in a public PR review before it is posted to an external contributor's pull request (spring-ai PR #6408, branch GH-2133). Be skeptical and precise — a wrong line number or overstated claim would embarrass the reviewer.\n\n` +
    `Open the file and READ the cited lines (and surrounding context) in the repo at ${REPO}:\n` +
    `  File: ${it.file}\n  Cited lines: ${it.lines}\n\n` +
    `CLAIM TO VERIFY:\n${it.claim}\n\n` +
    `Decide:\n` +
    `- anchorCorrect: do the cited line numbers actually contain the cited code? (small off-by-a-few is a fix-anchor, not confirm)\n` +
    `- claimAccurate: is the described behavior/defect actually true?\n` +
    `- overstated: is any wording stronger than evidence supports?\n` +
    `- verdict: confirm | fix-anchor (claim true but line numbers need adjusting — give exact correct lines) | soften (claim partly true / overstated — give reworded claim) | reject (claim false).\n` +
    `Quote the exact code lines you read as evidence. Set id="${it.id}".`,
    { label: `verify:${it.id}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: SCHEMA }
  )
))).filter(Boolean)

return {
  total: verdicts.length,
  confirmed: verdicts.filter(v => v.verdict === 'confirm').length,
  needsChange: verdicts.filter(v => v.verdict !== 'confirm'),
  all: verdicts,
}

all.evidence:
buildImagePrompt (GoogleGenAiImageModel.java L187-211):
  L192-193: GoogleGenAiImageOptions.Builder builder = GoogleGenAiImageOptions.builder().from(this.options)
  L194: .model(ModelOptionsUtils.mergeOption(requestOptions.getModel(), this.options.getModel()))
  L199-201: if (requestOptions instanceof GoogleGenAiImageOptions googleOptions) { builder.from(googleOptions); }

GoogleGenAiImageOptions constructor (L132): this.model = (model != null ? model : DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME); -- always bakes a non-null model (DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME = GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_IMAGE, L36).

Builder.from (L294-297): public Builder from(GoogleGenAiImageOptions fromOptions) { if (StringUtils.hasText(fromOptions.getModel())) { this.model = fromOptions.getModel(); } ... } -- the hasText guard never excludes the model because the baked default always has text, so .from(googleOptions) at L200 re-applies the per-request model unconditionally.

mergeOption (ModelOptionsUtils.java L38-40): return runtimeValue == null ? defaultValue : runtimeValue; -- since requestOptions.getModel() is never null (baked default), L194 already returns the per-request default, and L200 re-confirms it. A per-request options object that never called .model(...) therefore carries DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME and silently overrides the model-level configured model.

Constructor line 132 (file GoogleGenAiImageOptions.java):
132  this.model = (model != null ? model : DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME);
Field declaration (line 45): private final @Nullable String model; and DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME (line 36) = GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_IMAGE name. So the constructor coalesces a null model to the default, making model non-null for every instance built this way.

Merge is null-skip: ModelOptionsUtils.mergeOption (lines 38-40): "return runtimeValue == null ? defaultValue : runtimeValue;".
GoogleGenAiImageModel.buildImagePrompt line 194: .model(ModelOptionsUtils.mergeOption(requestOptions.getModel(), this.options.getModel())). Because getModel() (line 156-158 returns this.model) is always non-null for a GoogleGenAiImageOptions instance, requestOptions.getModel() can never be null, so the merge never falls through to the instance default and an unset model is indistinguishable from one explicitly set to DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME. Claim confirmed.

L47: `			GoogleGenAiImageConnectionProperties connectionProperties) throws IOException {` — method declares throws IOException.
L64-65: `				GoogleCredentials credentials = GoogleCredentials` / `					.fromStream(connectionProperties.getCredentialsUri().getInputStream());` — a GoogleCredentials local is loaded from credentials-uri.
L66-67: `				// Note: Credentials are handled automatically by the SDK when using` / `				// Vertex AI mode` — misleading comment.
The local `credentials` is never referenced again; the only builder calls are connectionBuilder.apiKey(...) (L53), connectionBuilder.projectId(...).location(...) (L60-61). So `credentials` is a dead variable and credentials-uri has no effect. Note: the builder is GoogleGenAiImageConnectionDetails.builder() (`connectionBuilder`), not literally a Client builder, but the substance — creds never passed to any builder — is correct.

L216: `configBuilder.responseModalities("TEXT", "IMAGE");` requests both TEXT and IMAGE modalities. The response-parsing pipeline L146-172 maps only inline image data: L153-157 `.map(Content::parts) / .flatMap(Optional::stream) / .flatMap(List::stream) / .map(Part::inlineData) / .flatMap(Optional::stream)`. `Part::inlineData` returns Optional<Blob>; the subsequent `flatMap(Optional::stream)` discards every Part whose inlineData is empty (i.e., text Parts). The only sink is L158-169 building Image/ImageGeneration from `blob`. When a candidate returns only text Parts (a refusal/safety message with no image), all Parts are filtered out, `generationList` (L146,170) is empty, and L172 `new ImageResponse(generationList, new ImageResponseMetadata())` is returned with no exception, log, or error metadata — confirming a silent empty result with no signal.

L163: `final Image image = new Image(null, b64Json);` — and Image.java L35-37 `public Image(@Nullable String url, @Nullable String b64Json) { this.url = url; ... }` with L40-42 `getUrl() { return this.url; }`, so url is null and getUrl() returns null.
L165-166: `GoogleGenAiImageGenerationMetadata metadata = new GoogleGenAiImageGenerationMetadata(null, null, blob.mimeType().orElse(null), image.getUrl());`
GoogleGenAiImageGenerationMetadata.java L41-47 constructor signature is `(enhancedPrompt, raiFilteredReason, mimeType, gcsUri)`. Thus enhancedPrompt=null, raiFilteredReason=null, gcsUri=image.getUrl()=null; only mimeType is populated.
L172: `ImageResponse response = new ImageResponse(generationList, new ImageResponseMetadata());` — empty no-arg ImageResponseMetadata.
The claim correctly limits the "always null" fields to gcsUri/enhancedPrompt/raiFilteredReason and excludes mimeType, matching the code exactly.

L111: `final ImagePrompt imagePrompt = buildImagePrompt(prompt);` builds imagePrompt from the original prompt arg. L132: `final List<Content> contents = prompt.getInstructions()` iterates the ORIGINAL prompt arg, not imagePrompt. This is the only `.getInstructions()` call inside call() (grep confirms L132). The cited line range 110-132 contains both: L110 `public ImageResponse call(ImagePrompt prompt) {`, L111 the buildImagePrompt assignment, and L132 the prompt.getInstructions() iteration. Note for context: buildImagePrompt at L210 returns `new ImagePrompt(imagePrompt.getInstructions(), mergedOptions)`, copying instructions verbatim and only merging options — so the two instruction lists are currently equivalent and there is no functional output difference today; the claim correctly describes the inconsistency without asserting a behavioral bug.

GoogleGenAiImageConnectionProperties.java L33: `public static final String CONFIG_PREFIX = "spring.ai.google.genai.image";` and L59: `private boolean vertexAi;`. Sibling GoogleGenAiImageProperties.java L35: `public static final String CONFIG_PREFIX = "spring.ai.google.genai.image";` (same prefix). Both annotated `@ConfigurationProperties(...CONFIG_PREFIX)`. The image connection autoconfig (GoogleGenAiImageConnectionAutoConfiguration.java L46-71) reads only getApiKey()/getProjectId()/getLocation()/getCredentialsUri() and never calls isVertexAi(). A module-wide grep shows isVertexAi() is only invoked in chat/GoogleGenAiChatAutoConfiguration.java L80 and L91 against the unrelated GoogleGenAiConnectionProperties class, never against the image connection properties — so the image vertexAi field is bound but never read.

nav.adoc L51-54 exactly as cited:
51: *** xref:api/imageclient.adoc[Image Models]
52: **** xref:api/image/azure-openai-image.adoc[Azure OpenAI]
53: **** xref:api/image/openai-image.adoc[OpenAI]
54: **** xref:api/image/stabilityai-image.adoc[Stability]

grep for "google-genai-image|google-genai|genai-image" in nav.adoc returns ONLY:
25: **** xref:api/chat/google-genai-chat.adoc[Google GenAI]
40: **** xref:api/embeddings/google-genai-embeddings-text.adoc[Google GenAI Text Embedding]
No image entry for google-genai exists in nav.adoc. Confirmed the file pages/api/image/google-genai-image.adoc DOES exist on disk (ls output) but is not linked in nav -- a genuine orphan.

imageclient.adoc Available Implementations:
158: == Available Implementations
162: * xref:api/image/openai-image.adoc[OpenAI Image Generation]
163: * xref:api/image/stabilityai-image.adoc[StabilityAI Image Generation]
Lists openai and stabilityai, no google-genai (and no azure-openai either, but claim only asserts the two present, which is accurate).

Doc samples (google-genai-image.adoc):
L223-224 (Using API Key):
  ImageResponse imageResponse = imageModel
  	.call("A painting of a sunset over a mountain");
L243-244 (Using Vertex AI):
  ImageResponse imageResponse = imageModel
  	.call("A painting of a sunset over a mountain");

ImageModel.java L24: `ImageResponse call(ImagePrompt request);` (only method, @FunctionalInterface).
Model.java L38: `TRes call(TReq request);` (super-interface, only call method).
GoogleGenAiImageModel.java L110: `public ImageResponse call(ImagePrompt prompt) {` (only call() in concrete class; grep found no other `call` definition).

No String overload of call() exists in the interface, super-interface, or concrete class, so imageModel.call("...") does not compile. Claim confirmed. (Minor: the call is split across two lines and assigned to ImageResponse, but cited lines 223-224 and 243-244 are exact.)

Doc L183: `The https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-ai/blob/main/models/spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java[GoogleGenAiImageModel] implements the `ImageModel`.` — the URL path is .../org/springframework/ai/google/genai/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java (no /image/). Actual repo file: /Users/ddobrin/work/dan/spring-ai/models/spring-ai-google-genai-image/src/main/java/org/springframework/ai/google/genai/image/GoogleGenAiImageModel.java, and L17 of that file: `package org.springframework.ai.google.genai.image;`. The link omits the /image/ package segment, so the blob URL points to a nonexistent path and 404s.
